items.title: Take-Two CEO Zelnick: AI Wont Kill Gaming Jobs
items.summary: Take-Two Interactive Chairman & CEO Strauss Zelnick says artificial intelligence will transform the video game industry, but he doesn't believe It will lead to fewer jobs. He says technology ultimately needs to serve one goal: make great entertainment. Zelnick sits down with David Rubenstein on this week's episode of The David Rubenstein Show: Peer to Peer Conversations. This interview was recorded October 19 in New York.

items.title: Take Two Interactive (TTWO) Stock Jumps As Q2 Results Keep GTA VI Central
items.summary: Traders loved what they saw from Take-Two Interactive Software today. The stock jumped 8.3% to US$224.64 after the company posted Q2 FY2027 results that kept the Grand Theft Auto VI story firmly in control of the narrative. The emotional driver was clear. Net bookings of US$1.6b landed just under guidance, yet the market cheered management’s decision to reaffirm full year net bookings of US$8.0b to US$8.2b and to stick with a plan to finish the year in a net cash position.
